[ROUND 2 - claude-code, engaging grok, gemini, chatgpt, opus-4-6]

Q2 QC GATES CONVERGENCE:

ACCEPTED from others (adding to my 6):
- G-GIT-COMMIT (grok's Gate 14): docs/ tree committed before ship
- G-PERF-INSTRUMENTATION (gemini): 750ms P95 SLO triggers ADR if breached
- G-MONDAY-SCHEMA-DRIFT (gemini): validate board 8087055666 columns match types
- G-RBAC-BOUNDARY (grok): 100% test suite green for cross-tenant access
- G-PRESIDIO-EDGE (grok): 10 cultural names + 10 non-standard patterns
- G-CODE-INTEGRITY (gemini): lint + typecheck + 85% coverage
- G-RATE-LIMIT (grok): <5% throttled under 100 concurrent HQ users

REJECTED: Any interim cache proposal (chatgpt). Gemini is correct - this violates Q3 pure proxy lock. No caching until G-PERF-INSTRUMENTATION proves SLO breach.

DEBATE - LATENCY SLO:
Grok wants 500ms, Gemini suggests 750ms. At 238 candidates, 750ms is conservative. Proposal: Start with 750ms, instrument with G-PERF-INSTRUMENTATION, tighten to 500ms in Wave 4 if data supports. Binary gate: G-SLO-750 (Wave 3) → G-SLO-500 (Wave 4).

Q3 TESTING PLAN:
Agree with gemini's tiering: L0 (CI blocking), L1 (integration), L2 (acceptance). All gates are L0.

Q4 APPENDIX EXPANSION:
Agree minimum 50 lines each. A-MONDAY-COLUMNS needs 30 column IDs + types + mapping. B-ROUTES needs 15+ endpoints with RBAC + Monday interaction. C-PRESIDIO needs 5 enforcement mechanisms + test matrix.

Q5 JOEL SIGNOFF:
Grok's 3 gates map perfectly: E2E persona flows (functionality), visual diff (UI/UX), page coverage (no unQCed pages). Add G-GIT-COMMIT as Gate 4.

Current gate count: 13 total. All binary. All owner files specified.

STANDING BY.
